gensokyolegacy.lore.broom_lore: It flies itself, given there is somebody left to fly.
gensokyolegacy.lore.cat_bell_lore: Small, and heavier than any bell has a right to be.
gensokyolegacy.lore.centipickaxe_lore: A pickaxe with a taste for blood, and a habit of hanging on to it.
gensokyolegacy.lore.doll_lance_lore: A polearm built to a doll's reach rather than a hand's.
gensokyolegacy.lore.dowser_lore: Nazrin's dowser. Borrowed, and never returned.
gensokyolegacy.lore.fairy_wings_lore: A fairy's wing, priced at half of whatever the wearer has.
gensokyolegacy.lore.fancy_fan_lore: Pretty enough to give away, and it blows when you wave it.
gensokyolegacy.lore.furnace_1_lore: A portable magical furnace that emits heat. Can slowly smelt adjacent items when placed in inventory.
gensokyolegacy.lore.furnace_2_lore: A portable magical furnace with the leaks sealed. Smelts what you put in it, and rather too fast at that.
gensokyolegacy.lore.ice_wings_lore: Six crystals, and it is suddenly very hard to count past nine.
gensokyolegacy.lore.iron_dagger_lore: Thrown, not dropped — it knows the way back.
gensokyolegacy.lore.koishi_hat_lore: Taken off a third party, and it never stopped sulking about it.
gensokyolegacy.lore.mermaid_pearl_lore: Still wet, and still listening to something a long way down.
gensokyolegacy.lore.minamitsu_anchor_lor: Heavy enough to stop a ship, and it still comes back.
gensokyolegacy.lore.mini_shield_lore: Too small for a hand, but a doll can still get behind it.
gensokyolegacy.lore.nue_trident_lore: The one you throw is never the one you keep.
gensokyolegacy.lore.star_wand_lore: Throws the star, keeps the wand.
gensokyolegacy.lore.strange_glasses_lore: Someone else's idea of what counts as real.
gensokyolegacy.lore.straw_hat_lore: Woven by someone with four legs, for a frog with a very large appetite.
gensokyolegacy.lore.suwako_hat_lore: A river god's hat, traded for a frog's very specific appetite.
gensokyolegacy.lore.ufo_lore: Something in there is waiting to be let out.
gensokyolegacy.lore.yuyuko_fan_lore: A fan full of ghosts, and not one of them will stay still.

gensokyolegacy/alice/chat/dialog/alice/c: All by myself? Not quite — I have my dolls for company, so the mansion is hardly lonely.
gensokyolegacy/alice/chat/greeting: Oh - a visitor. Do come in. Is there something you need?
gensokyolegacy/alice/chat/party_greeting: Thanks for having me. Did you make all of this yourself? Quite impressive.
gensokyolegacy/alice/chat/starter/start: Is this mansion just for you?
gensokyolegacy/alice/chat/trade: I would like to trade for something.
gensokyolegacy/alice/chat/visit_greeting: ...What a coincidence. You are a guest as well.
gensokyolegacy/alice/chat_star_wand/dial: A doll is a delicate piece of magic equipment - it cannot do much on its own. The lance I gave you is the simplest thing I can put in a doll's hand: it charges in like a wasp, and it delivers. But if you would rather keep your distance, the doll has to have a wand in its hand.
Another resident of the Magical Forest, the owner of the Kirisame Magic Shop, has things like that — but you'll have to get on good terms with her first.
gensokyolegacy/alice/daily_doll/dialog/a: Thank you. Let me just check the materials.
The quality is very good, I accept them. As payment, here is a doll and a custom-made cavalry lance - take good care of it.
Then I will write you a fresh list.
Good. I will leave it to you.
Very well. Everything I need is on this list.
I need a few things for a magic project. I have had one of my dolls write the list out for you - gather it for me. In return, I will make a doll of your own.
gensokyolegacy/alice/daily_doll/option/c: I have what you asked for.
gensokyolegacy/alice/daily_doll/quest/de: Collect the cloth, straw and iron Alice needs for her dolls, plus a few dyes.
gensokyolegacy/alice/first_doll/dialog/a: Very well. Let me look at the materials.
Thank you for your help. This is the payment we agreed on.
Let me show you the list again. These materials are actually quite common in the Magical Forest.
Take your time. None of those materials are hard to come by.
These are the materials I need. Once they're gathered, I can start.

Curious about my dolls? Doll-making is my specialty. You've helped me a great deal — I could make one for you, but I'm short on materials right now. Bring me what I need, and I'll show you what a doll can do.
Is that so? I must have misunderstood, then.
gensokyolegacy/alice/first_doll/option/c: I have everything you asked for.
gensokyolegacy/alice/first_doll/option/f: I would like to see the list again.
gensokyolegacy/alice/first_doll/option/s: Really? Then let me prepare the materials.
Just a quick look, maybe later.
gensokyolegacy/alice/first_doll/quest/de: Bring Alice the materials every doll is made of.
gensokyolegacy/alice/gift/dialog/dislike: Mm, thank you, but I'm afraid I can't accept this one.
gensokyolegacy/alice/gift/dialog/like: What a curious thing. I'll keep it — you must come try my red tea sometime.
gensokyolegacy/alice/gift/dialog/neutral: Thank you for the gift. I'll accept it, then.
gensokyolegacy/alice/gift/dialog/return: I've prepared a little something in return. It's not much, but it's yours.
gensokyolegacy/alice/gift/option/like/le: I'll be sure to come by.
gensokyolegacy/alice/seven_colors/dialog: Good, this is the last step. Hand me the materials — it will be done soon.
Here: the glove, a doll to match it, and a lance. Go and try it out - I will ask you now and then how it feels in use.
Red, orange, yellow, light green, cyan, light blue, purple - four of each.
The forest is never short of colors. What it lacks is persistence.
Then it is settled. Four of each - read the requirements over carefully before you go.

Controlling a doll is not easy to learn. But I have a project going now: getting people who know no magic to work a doll. It takes seven dyes, four of each - the colors tell the different commands apart. Will you help me?
Very well. Do think it over.
gensokyolegacy/alice/seven_colors/option: I forgot which colors they were.
gensokyolegacy/alice/seven_colors/quest/: Bring Alice four of each of the seven dyes the Doll Glove is woven from.
gensokyolegacy/alice/shared/option/daily: [Daily] Sorry, I forgot what the list said.
gensokyolegacy/alice/visit_marisa_house/: Good day. I came for some magical materials - are you here for the same?
It is. I rarely go out, but materials still need restocking now and then; a change of scenery is nice for a while.
Yes. She does not do everything by herself - she hands out commissions, brews potions, and now and then turns up with tools of unclear provenance. That last part is better left unasked about.
Let's talk again some other time.
I heard she sells more than materials?
What a coincidence - you are here to see her as well?
This is awfully far from where you live.
gensokyolegacy/cirno/chat/dialog/cirno/c: These frogs are the proof of my training! Don't worry, I'll thaw them out. They've only been frozen for... a few days now?
gensokyolegacy/cirno/chat/greeting: Did you come to play with me?
gensokyolegacy/cirno/chat/option/hi/end: I'm a little worried about these little guys' future.
gensokyolegacy/cirno/chat/party_greeting: I heard you're treating? Then I won't hold back!
gensokyolegacy/cirno/gift/dialog/dislike: I don't like this one. You keep it.
gensokyolegacy/cirno/gift/dialog/like: You're so nice! I really like this!
gensokyolegacy/cirno/gift/dialog/neutral: A present? Then I'll take it~
gensokyolegacy/cirno/gift/dialog/return: I found this outside! It's yours now. Come play with me again, okay?
gensokyolegacy/cirno/gift/option/return/: It's a date! I'll come find you.
gensokyolegacy/marisa/brewing/dialog/mar: Blaze rods and nether wart — now I can finally study this 'brewing' business. Thanks again this time!
Blaze rods and nether wart — I'm itchin' to fire up a brewing stand and study 'em!
Different understandings, then — but what you describe interests me too. Fetch me some of both — price is negotiable!
Fine, tell me when you're free?
gensokyolegacy/marisa/brewing/option/com: We each get what we need.
gensokyolegacy/marisa/brewing/option/sta: Come to think of it, brewing here is nothing like those witches' — shouldn't it be blazes and nether wart based?
gensokyolegacy/marisa/brewing/quest/desc: Bring Marisa blaze rods and nether wart.
gensokyolegacy/marisa/chat/dialog/marisa: Used to get plenty, but everything around here changed big-time lately — no idea where my customers went.
gensokyolegacy/marisa/chat/greeting: Yo, hey~ welcome to the Kirisame Magic Shop!
gensokyolegacy/marisa/chat/party_greetin: Thanks for the treat - time to dig in~
gensokyolegacy/marisa/chat_alice/dialog/: There's a mansion in the forest, home to Alice. She studies magic like me, but wears a scowl all day; the two of us are always butting heads. But when you actually need help, she's warm-hearted — you should get to know her.
Not exactly — magic users have their own specialties. She's better with dolls; if that interests you, she's the one to see.
gensokyolegacy/marisa/chat_alice/option/: Is she as good at potions as you are?
gensokyolegacy/marisa/chat_alice/starter: Are there any other magic users in this forest?
gensokyolegacy/marisa/chat_morichika/dia: Funny you mention tools — not all my trinkets are handmade. There's another shop in the Magical Forest, Kourindou, run by an old acquaintance of mine.

He buys and sells all sorts of trinkets and tools — call it a secondhand shop. If you need gear for exploring, he may have something. Everything from charms to junk, and he buys everyday supplies too.
gensokyolegacy/marisa/chat_morichika/opt: I'll have to pay it a visit sometime.
gensokyolegacy/marisa/chat_morichika/sta: I wish I had tools to aid exploration…
gensokyolegacy/marisa/chat_reimu/dialog/: You'll find the Hakurei Shrine in the cherry grove — an old friend of mine is there, good with spells for all sorts of trouble. If you're heading somewhere dangerous, she may give you something useful in a fight.
She's easygoing; I think as long as you don't go too far, there won't be a problem.
gensokyolegacy/marisa/chat_reimu/option/: Anything I should know before visiting?
I'll pay a visit when I get the chance.
gensokyolegacy/marisa/chat_reimu/starter: Do you know anyone skilled in a fight?
gensokyolegacy/marisa/daily_brewing/dial: Oh, you got 'em? Let me see.
Blaze rods and nether wart — remember!
Hurry back — the brew waits for no one!
Brewin' up a storm over here, and I'm fresh outta base ingredients! Please head to the Nether and grab me some blaze rods and nether wart.
Fine, I'll wait a bit longer.
gensokyolegacy/marisa/daily_brewing/opti: Could you go over the task again?
All right, I'll get on it.
gensokyolegacy/marisa/daily_brewing/ques: Bring Marisa blaze rods and nether wart.
gensokyolegacy/marisa/daily_mycelium/dia: Oh, you got 'em? Let me see!
Take a look at the list.
That's the spirit — these are what I need this time.
My stock's runnin' low again — bring me a batch of forest mushrooms.
gensokyolegacy/marisa/daily_mycelium/opt: What mushrooms did you need again?
gensokyolegacy/marisa/daily_shroomlight/: Oh? Did you get the materials?
That's the one — here, your hard-earned pay~
Nether fungus and shroomlight — don't forget.
I need more Nether shroomlights and fungus — help me out~
What did I need from the Nether again?
All right, I'll get on it.
Bring Marisa shroomlights and nether fungus.
gensokyolegacy/marisa/daily_talisman/dia: Good, waiting for you to get back!
Thanks! This is what the request needs~
The talisman papers are all used up — help me make another trip to Reimu's and buy a few talismans, would ya?
gensokyolegacy/marisa/daily_talisman/opt: What talismans did you need again?
gensokyolegacy/marisa/daily_talisman/que: Bring Marisa healing talisman papers from Reimu.
gensokyolegacy/marisa/daily_witchcraft/d: Thanks for the work — you're not hurt, are you?
These are the materials I need.
I'll get ready — waiting for you to get back.
Thanks — here are the requirements, take a look.
I'm mid-brew and running short on materials — can you get me some monster materials?
That's a problem — guess I'll take my time on my own.
gensokyolegacy/marisa/daily_witchcraft/o: Safe and sound (Hand over the items)
Could you go over the task again?
gensokyolegacy/marisa/daily_witchcraft/q: Bring Marisa rotten flesh, spider eyes, and miasma mushrooms.
gensokyolegacy/marisa/first_mushroom/dia: Really? Then I can start my research.
These are just right — thanks a ton!
Hey, I'm not that kind of client — so how's the job going?
You're a lifesaver! — Eight red and eight brown mushrooms'll do. Bring me the good stuff!

This area's still real strange to me — even the forest plants look different. I'm just getting my magic research started and I'm short on honest-to-goodness samples. How about fetching me some local mushrooms?
Aw, c'mon~ Mushrooms are the foundation of every potion recipe — you'd be helping real magic research here!
gensokyolegacy/marisa/first_mushroom/opt: I brought what you asked for.
Just double-checking — the request hasn't changed, right?
I saw some requests posted outside your shop?
Okay, wait for me to get back.
gensokyolegacy/marisa/first_mushroom/que: Bring Marisa red and brown mushrooms from the surface.
gensokyolegacy/marisa/gift/dialog/dislik: Er, I just remembered something's on the stove. Hold on to this one, will you?
gensokyolegacy/marisa/gift/dialog/like: Wow, you really get me. I love this!
gensokyolegacy/marisa/gift/dialog/neutra: Hehe, thanks! I'll take it, then.
gensokyolegacy/marisa/gift/dialog/return: Ta-da! I picked this out myself. Hope it's useful!
gensokyolegacy/marisa/golden_apple/dialo: Look at that glow — that's genuine lost technology. I'm gonna learn every secret inside, and build my own!
Wait for my good news — I'll be able to make these for you later!
You mean the enchanted golden apple — found one?
I hear there are lots of abandoned buildings underground — rummage through chests and you'll run into one.
No pressure — the request has no deadline.

Ever seen those fancy golden apples — the enchanted kind? Nobody in this world knows how to make 'em anymore, but I can figure it out! Find me one as a sample, and once I've researched it I can reproduce it — whaddaya say?
If you happen to find one, you can reconsider — let's leave it for now.
gensokyolegacy/marisa/golden_apple/optio: Finally — never mind how I got it, I found one.
It's really not that easy to find.
Finally a request that's not about mushrooms?
Whether you take it or not is the same, really — don't get your hopes up too high.
Too hard to find — maybe later.
gensokyolegacy/marisa/golden_apple/quest: Bring Marisa an enchanted golden apple.
gensokyolegacy/marisa/hakkero/dialog/mar: Let's see... redstone, gold, and iron — right, the netherite is the truly crucial part... There! Feel the difference? It runs cooler now, and smelting doesn't take as long.
Eight redstone, four gold, sixteen iron, one netherite scrap — and don't forget to bring the prototype itself.

Eight redstone for conduction, four gold for contacts, sixteen iron to shore up the casing, plus one netherite scrap to anchor the whole structure. Don't worry — it'll be much stronger than the prototype.
I feel nostalgic about this thing — the old man sells it as a curiosity, but the shape is interesting. If I gather the materials, I can improve it for you, at least make it less hot to the touch.
Then just find me when you want to upgrade it; I have experience.
gensokyolegacy/marisa/hakkero/option/com: Here - the parts, and the prototype.
The furnace really doesn't leak heat now.
Huh, you know, that thing's practically a workshop in one hand.
gensokyolegacy/marisa/hakkero/option/fol: Just to confirm - the parts for the repair?
gensokyolegacy/marisa/hakkero/option/sta: All right, I'll go get the stuff.
I think it works fine as is, maybe later.
gensokyolegacy/marisa/hakkero/quest/desc: Hand Marisa your Mini Hakkero Prototype and the parts to repair it.
gensokyolegacy/marisa/huge_mushroom/dial: This is it — thanks a lot.
Now I've got dinner and research sorted!
I need whole blocks of those giant mushrooms — got any yet? I can hardly wait!

Speaking of which — have ya seen the mushrooms around here? They're practically trees! Never seen anything this huge, real whoppers. I tried pluckin' one and it just shattered into little bits. There's gotta be a proper way to harvest the whole thing. Think ya can bring me some whole giant mushroom blocks?
That's your specialty, right? Give me a hand.
gensokyolegacy/marisa/huge_mushroom/opti: This is what you asked for.
Can't be helped — I'll get them for you.
Wait for me to get back.
This stuff is hard to get without enchantments.
I don't have the enchantment yet, wait a bit longer.
gensokyolegacy/marisa/koishi_hat/dialog/: As expected of you — I never thought this commission would be completed; I was using it as a notice board.
Haha! So that's how it was. You keep this hat — I know what's going on now.
Best if nothing's wrong — but if you hear a bell, be careful.
If nobody had really been hurt, I doubt anyone would've actually commissioned an investigation. Better safe than sorry.

Heard the news coming outta the Nether lately? Travelers comin' back white as sheets, swearin' somethin' followed 'em home — but none can say what. Bring a shield before you go; witnesses claim they heard a strange bell, then took a sharp blow to the back without ever seeing the attacker. You're a real fighter — how about poking around the Nether for me?
gensokyolegacy/marisa/koishi_hat/option/: I ran into it and got out unscathed. No idea who it was in the end, but judging by the hat they dropped, it seems solved.
Here, look at the hat left at the scene.
Then I'll take it with a clear conscience.
Hm — nothing seems to be happening?
Is this really not just a popular urban legend?
What's with the hush-hush request — what's going on?
Sounds dangerous — I'll keep an eye out.
gensokyolegacy/marisa/koishi_hat/quest/d: Marisa heard unsettling rumors about the Nether. Investigate — carefully.
gensokyolegacy/marisa/nether_mushroom_pr: Wow, look at this — it's like a living chunk of sulfur! That this world's plants can adapt to that place is fascinating. Amazing research material — thank you!
I need Nether mushrooms — found any yet? I hear they grow like weeds down there.
Knew I could count on ya! Bring those mushrooms back safe!

The big-nosed residents here say the mushrooms down there are something else entirely. No way I'm going there myself — all that fire and lava, nothing like the Former Hell. But you've been there, right? Bring me some Nether mushrooms!
Then come back when you're free.
You're too kind — I got paid for it.
I saw the new request — has your mushroom obsession spread to the Nether?
I know the place — I can handle this.
gensokyolegacy/marisa/shroomlight/dialog: Ohhh, so pretty! Look at the veins inside! The magic must flow right through here.
Take care down there — don't get turned into a mushroom yourself!
Now we're talkin'! It's called shroomlight, right? Bring back eight.
I hear the Nether has giant mushrooms too, with a glowing core inside, right? I want that thing — bring me back a few.
Hehe, I didn't know about this stuff last time — one more trip, pretty please.
gensokyolegacy/marisa/shroomlight/option: The glowy ones are usually poisonous, right?
What's this glowing mushroom in the request?
Why didn't you have me bring it last time...
gensokyolegacy/marisa/talisman_request/d: Haha, I really couldn't have asked her myself without you — sorry for the trouble.
I've got good stuff for you — a broom I whittled this morning, and a star wand I made. With the broom you won't have to worry about running errands at all~
Healing papers — Reimu sells 'em at the shrine — four of 'em, burn that into your brain!
Her prices are brutal, huh? I'll pay you back once you've bought them!
Great! Four healing papers — no knockoffs, got it?

Say — you've seen Reimu's talisman papers, right? Lately my experiments keep leaving me a mess; my safety measures still aren't good enough, so I thought of these. Buy me a few. And... don't tell her they're for me, okay?
Reimu charges even me full price — and she'd tease me about it forever. Just help me out here.
gensokyolegacy/marisa/talisman_request/o: Running errands really is a hassle.
This really is much more convenient — I'll take it.
What was I supposed to buy again?
Ugh, so I'm fronting the money after all.
Aren't you two close? Why not just ask her?
gensokyolegacy/marisa/talisman_request/q: Bring Marisa healing talisman papers from Reimu.
gensokyolegacy/marisa/visit_kourindou/di: Everyone has their own taste - and maybe I only come out here for the novelty of walking around.
Kinda cramped, but I like it. Somehow this place gets my brain going better than my own shop.
gensokyolegacy/marisa/visit_kourindou/op: Not thinking of redecorating your own shop?
gensokyolegacy/marisa/visit_shrine/dialo: Too quiet, all right. Quiet enough to hear mushrooms growing! A shrine with nothing going on is always this peaceful - might be a good place to retire to, actually.
The offering box is basically always empty — the coins visitors donate probably don't even match what the youkai toss in when they gather to drink.
Youkai are part of the balance too — it's not like I exterminate every youkai I see. In other words, even humans who try to upset the balance become targets.
gensokyolegacy/marisa/visit_shrine/optio: Isn't this a place for exterminating youkai? Why do youkai come here to party?
Seems my understanding was too one-sided.
gensokyolegacy/marisa/visit_shrine/start: It's quiet up here, isn't it?
Does anyone actually put money in the offering box?
gensokyolegacy/minamitsu/chat/greeting: Welcome to Myouren Temple. What brings you here?
gensokyolegacy/minamitsu/chat/party_gree: It's lively here. Thank you for inviting me to eat.
gensokyolegacy/minamitsu/chat/trade: Do you have anything for sale?
gensokyolegacy/minamitsu/chat/visit_gree: What a coincidence. I'm out running errands — what do you need?
gensokyolegacy/minamitsu/gift/dialog/dis: I've no use for this. You'd better keep it.
gensokyolegacy/minamitsu/gift/dialog/lik: You have a good eye. I'll take it, then.
gensokyolegacy/minamitsu/gift/dialog/neu: A gift? Don't mind if I do.
gensokyolegacy/minamitsu/gift/dialog/ret: Here — I hauled this up a while back, it's yours.
gensokyolegacy/morichika/chat/dialog/mor: Welcome to Kourindou! Let me know if anything catches your eye.
gensokyolegacy/morichika/chat/greeting: Welcome to Kourindou! Feel free to look around.
gensokyolegacy/morichika/chat/party_gree: Thanks for the meal. The food is good — sit down and join us.
gensokyolegacy/morichika/chat/starter/st: A shop like this, out in the forest?
gensokyolegacy/morichika/chat/trade: Let me see what you are selling?
gensokyolegacy/morichika/chat/visit_gree: Good to see you again. Everything going alright?
gensokyolegacy/morichika/chat_marisa/dia: There's a magician deep in the Magical Forest. She loves mushrooms, magic tools, and borrowing things without asking — if brewing troubles you, go find her; she may make it easier for you.
Follow the mushrooms — and the explosions. Tell her I sent you.
gensokyolegacy/morichika/chat_marisa/sta: Brewing potions is such a hassle…
gensokyolegacy/morichika/chat_reimu/dial: She's easygoing. As long as you don't do anything out of the ordinary, there are no real restrictions.
There's a shrine maiden in the cherry grove. If you feel short of ways to protect yourself, go and ask her for a talisman - it will keep you alive when danger comes.
gensokyolegacy/morichika/gift/dialog/dis: Er, the shop has no room for this. You take it back, customer.
gensokyolegacy/morichika/gift/dialog/lik: How did you know I liked this? I'll accept your kind offer, then.
gensokyolegacy/morichika/gift/dialog/neu: You're too kind — bringing a gift to my shop. I'm quite flattered.
gensokyolegacy/morichika/gift/dialog/ret: Thanks for your patronage lately. I picked this out for you — do come again.
gensokyolegacy/morichika/gift/option/ret: Thank you. I'll be sure to visit.
gensokyolegacy/nazrin/chat/greeting: Hold still — my dowsers are twitching, and they never twitch for nothing.
gensokyolegacy/nazrin/chat/party_greetin: A feast? Fine, but only if the food is worth the trip.
gensokyolegacy/nazrin/chat/trade: What do you need from me?
gensokyolegacy/nazrin/chat/visit_greetin: Back again? There is always something worth digging up around here.
gensokyolegacy/nazrin/gift/dialog/dislik: I don't collect this sort of thing. You'd better keep it for yourself.
gensokyolegacy/nazrin/gift/dialog/like: Where did you find this treasure? Are you really giving it to me? You're so kind!
gensokyolegacy/nazrin/gift/dialog/neutra: I can feel the thought behind it. I'll take the gift.
gensokyolegacy/nazrin/gift/dialog/return: Here — I dug this up on the way. It's yours.
gensokyolegacy/nazrin/lost_tower/dialog/: Ha! That's Shou's tower — I'd know that gleam anywhere. She'll be insufferable about this. Hand it over.
Four stacks, counted. Spend it however you like — I know I would.
Much obliged. Now then — pick your payment. A little tower I put together myself, one of my dowsers, or a few stacks of coins? Choose one.
My spare dowser. It twitches for treasure, and only treasure. Take good care of it, or I'll know.
An ordinary wooden tower I infused with a spark of Shou's power. It holds only a fraction of the real thing — but a fraction of a treasure tower is still treasure. Don't lose it.
Nothing. Not a twitch. It's not anywhere near here — Shou carried it further than she thinks. Follow the path she took.
My dowsers say it's close — keep looking around here, on the surface. A treasure tower is not easy to miss.
Good. It is still out there, and it is above ground — Shou never buries anything. Follow the twitch and you'll have it.

Shou lost her treasure tower again — set it down somewhere and walked off without it. She has been tearing the temple apart, and my dowsers have been twitching since dawn. Lend me a hand: find it and bring it back, and I'll make it worth your while.
Tch. Fine. Shou and I will keep looking... after a nap.
gensokyolegacy/nazrin/lost_tower/quest/d: Help Nazrin find Shou's lost treasure tower and bring it back.
gensokyolegacy/nazrin/lost_tower/require: Find and pick up Shou's treasure tower
gensokyolegacy/nue/gift/dialog/dislike: This is still too much of a mystery to me. You'd better keep it.
gensokyolegacy/nue/gift/dialog/like: Thank you. I like this one.
gensokyolegacy/nue/gift/dialog/return: Take this. Don't ask me where it came from.
gensokyolegacy/reimu/chat/greeting: Oh? What brings you to the shrine?
gensokyolegacy/reimu/chat/party_greeting: A good meal is hard to come by. Oh, can I get this boxed up later?
gensokyolegacy/reimu/chat/trade: I've come to ask for ofuda!
gensokyolegacy/reimu/chat/visit_greeting: What a coincidence - you can be found here too.
gensokyolegacy/reimu/chat_duty/dialog/re: To put it simply, I maintain the balance of Gensokyo. Big trouble may need me to step in, but most days are actually quite leisurely and peaceful.
gensokyolegacy/reimu/chat_duty/starter/s: What are the Hakurei shrine maiden's duties?
gensokyolegacy/reimu/chat_fortune/dialog: Ah, a bad slip... try to visit fewer people today and keep a low profile.
Great blessing! Even I'm jealous. Take this luck — why not try opening a treasure chest?
Small blessing — nothing special. They say heaven rewards the diligent, so don't waste your time.
You can draw a fortune slip here once a day. It will show your fortune — want to take a look?
gensokyolegacy/reimu/chat_frog/dialog/re: Have you heard the legend of the native god? It is said to appear in the form of a frog, guarding the village the way a frog catches prey, swallowing only those who do evil... But there's no way to verify it; it may just be a folk tale.
There's the aura of a native god on this hat.
gensokyolegacy/reimu/chat_frog/option/as: I bought it back then because it looked unusual — is there something special about it?
gensokyolegacy/reimu/chat_frog/option/by: That's awfully detailed for a story.
gensokyolegacy/reimu/chat_guests/dialog/: Actually, not many guests come to the shrine — just the occasional acquaintance dropping by. It's very quiet... Whatever. Donations barely amount to anything anyway; it's good enough that anyone comes at all. At least it's lively.
gensokyolegacy/reimu/chat_marisa/dialog/: Ofuda borrow power from the gods, so they usually come with strings attached. Speaking of potions — have you met Marisa? She runs a shop deep in the Magical Forest. Her potions work differently from the usual brewing — go take a look if you're curious.
Her house is deep in the Magical Forest — follow the mushrooms and the explosions, you can't miss her.
gensokyolegacy/reimu/chat_marisa/starter: Which works better, ofuda or potions?
gensokyolegacy/reimu/chat_money/dialog/r: I don't have anything I like that much. If I had to say, I like anything that can cover my living needs.
gensokyolegacy/reimu/chat_power/dialog/r: My abilities? Differences in strength mean nothing to me — gravity, force, that sort of thing — so I can fly freely and fight anyone on equal footing.
gensokyolegacy/reimu/chat_shrine/dialog/: Oh, a visitor. This is the Hakurei Shrine — though if you came to worship, you'll have to wait a while. I still haven't figured out what's going on around here.
gensokyolegacy/reimu/chat_shrine_close/d: This place is a bit out of the way, but its feng shui is one of a kind — after all, this is the border between Gensokyo and the outside world, or at least that's what Yukari says... But being so remote has a downside: hardly anyone comes to worship.
gensokyolegacy/reimu/chat_shrine_close/o: (I'll visit the shrine more often from now on)
gensokyolegacy/reimu/daily_food/dialog/r: Oh, you got 'em? Let me see!
The donation box is empty again — bring a decent haul of supplies, remember.
The offering box is bone dry — at this rate I won't eat. Bring me a few things the shrine can use.
Then I'll think of something — maybe mooch a meal off her.
gensokyolegacy/reimu/daily_food/option/s: I have other things to do.
gensokyolegacy/reimu/daily_food/quest/de: Bring Reimu a few supplies for the shrine.
gensokyolegacy/reimu/daily_hunt/dialog/r: Oh, you got 'em? Let me see!
Finally, I can get a peaceful night's sleep.
Something's been stirring near the shrine again — thin them out and bring back their loot, remember.
Something's always stirring trouble near the shrine. Clear out those monsters and bring back their loot.
Ugh, looks like I'll have to fight them myself.
gensokyolegacy/reimu/daily_hunt/option/s: I have other things to do.
gensokyolegacy/reimu/daily_hunt/quest/de: Thin out the monsters and bring Reimu some loot.
gensokyolegacy/reimu/daily_raid/dialog/r: Not bad — you're getting better at this.
Is that so? I can set a fresh one on you.
There. Same plan — I'll wait for good news.
Same as before — lure them in, hold the line, drive them out.
Another village has caught the eye of a raider band. I've got the bait ready — up for another cleanup?
The mark will keep. We'll talk when you're ready.
gensokyolegacy/reimu/daily_raid/option/c: I couldn't have drawn them out so smoothly without your help.
gensokyolegacy/reimu/daily_raid/quest/de: Win a raid with Reimu's mark to protect a village.
gensokyolegacy/reimu/daily_talisman/dial: Good. That'll last a while. Here's your share.
Ofuda stock is low again — paper and redstone, remember.
Good. Restock me and I'll keep a steady supply of ofuda.
Ofuda stock is running low again — paper and redstone, same as before. Gather some for me?
There's still a little left. We'll talk when you're free.
gensokyolegacy/reimu/daily_talisman/ques: Bring Reimu paper and redstone to restock her talismans.
gensokyolegacy/reimu/ender_materials/dia: Once placed, this gate will produce a linked gate in your hand. Place it elsewhere and it's done.
I hear they're common in a place called the warped forest. Give it a try.
One pearl and one eye, then. They're not easy for me to get — danmaku doesn't do much against them.
I travel through gaps, anchoring two places to each other. Bring me the medium it needs — I can teach you how to use it too.
No worries. We can talk when you're free.
gensokyolegacy/reimu/ender_materials/opt: The pearl and eye you asked for
The village says you arrive almost instantly when exterminating — how do you do it?
I've got other things to do.
gensokyolegacy/reimu/ender_materials/que: Bring Reimu an ender pearl and an ender eye for her gap research.
gensokyolegacy/reimu/gift/dialog/dislike: Ugh, what's this? Take it away, take it away.
gensokyolegacy/reimu/gift/dialog/like: Why are you giving me things all of a sudden... but I do like it, so I'll keep it.
gensokyolegacy/reimu/gift/dialog/return: Here — this is a thank-you for the gifts. Don't read anything into it.
gensokyolegacy/reimu/hostile_loot/dialog: Oh, you're back. How did it go?
That was quick. Guess you're no pushover. You didn't get hurt, did you? I wonder how the zombies here differ from the ones I know... With these I can confirm properly.
Oh — I see. While you're driving them off, bring back some of their materials. I want to see what kind of beings they are, so I can work out a better way to deal with them.
Alright, I'm counting on you. Don't mess it up — if you do, I'm not cleaning up after you— Just kidding. Good luck.
Speaking of which, those monsters wandering outside don't look like youkai, and sweeping them up is boring work. If you help drive some off, I can give you a reward — how about it, will you help?
Ah — is that so? Never mind if you don't want to.
gensokyolegacy/reimu/hostile_loot/option: You look worried — something on your mind?
gensokyolegacy/reimu/hostile_loot/quest/: Clear out zombies and skeletons for Reimu and collect their flesh and bones.
gensokyolegacy/reimu/local_food/dialog/r: You're back. How did it go?
Not bad, that was quick. Here, your reward.
Marisa always shares mushroom dishes at feasts — I kind of miss that taste. Are there any edible mushrooms around here? How about mushroom stew and bread?
The rations should last a while longer... though they taste awful. I'll wait for good news from you.
Thanks for the generous aid. I hope you can get it ready before I faint from hunger.
Let's not talk about whether I like it — I don't even know what's edible around here. The shrine's stockpiled rations are almost gone. Could you bring me some food?
Ah — is that so. Never mind, the shrine's rations should last me a while. I'll figure out what's edible around here myself.
gensokyolegacy/reimu/local_food/option/f: What do you like to eat?
That shouldn't be hard to find.
gensokyolegacy/reimu/local_food/option/s: Is the food here to your liking?
gensokyolegacy/reimu/local_food/quest/de: Bring Reimu some bread and mushroom stew so she can learn this world's food.
gensokyolegacy/reimu/ominous_banner/dial: Got it? Let me see the banner.
That's it. I'll study the calamity behind these raiders, and put an end to their balance-breaking.
Check outposts and patrols. That's where you're most likely to find one.
Good. Bring the banner back, and be careful.
I've exterminated them before — nothing special. They're upsetting the balance. If you're willing, bring me one of their banners. I don't think it's just a symbol.
Fine. They're just heretics anyway — I can handle them myself.
gensokyolegacy/reimu/ominous_banner/opti: Is it true what the raiders preach about defiling souls?
gensokyolegacy/reimu/ominous_banner/ques: Bring Reimu an ominous banner from a raid captain.
gensokyolegacy/reimu/raid/dialog/reimu/r: They stopped coming? Good — that saves a lot of work. Here — take this border umbrella, and be ready for what's coming.
The mark is fading. Want another? I can set a fresh one.
There. Enter the village, draw them out — you know what to do.
There. The mark is on you. Draw them out and destroy this balance-breaking force.
I've figured out that ominous mark. My ofuda can recreate it. I want to put it on you — can you draw the raiders out and drive them away?
I think you're strong enough. If you're not confident, forget it.
gensokyolegacy/reimu/raid/option/start: What's your plan for the raiders attacking villages lately?
gensokyolegacy/reimu/raid/quest/desc: Enter a village carrying Reimu's mark and repel the raiders.
gensokyolegacy/reimu/shared/option/daily: Could you go over the task again?
gensokyolegacy/reimu/talisman_materials/: You're back. Got all the materials?
So reliable. With these the shrine's ofuda stock is much fuller... Don't worry, I haven't forgotten your share. Here, take these.
You're back. How's the progress?
Then I'll wait for good news.
Alright, I'll leave it to you. Once the materials are gathered, I'll draw some ofuda as a reward.

You can't exterminate youkai without ofuda. I bet you've run into some nasty youkai on your travels — blades work, sure, but ofuda drive them off even better. The materials aren't too picky — redstone dust will do. I'm just running short. Wish I had a helper.
Because it takes natural ore to commune with the gods. The best ofuda are dotted with cinnabar — dye just won't cut it.
I'm back.
Here's what you asked for.
(Take the reward)
(Check gathering progress)
Still gathering.
(Take my leave)
What are these ofuda you mentioned?
I'll gather the materials for you.
(Leave)
If it's not picky, why not red dye?
That sounds pretty picky.
Bring Reimu paper and redstone for her new-world talismans.
Talisman Materials
gensokyolegacy/reimu/visit_kourindou/dia: Hard to say. Most of it is no use to me... and sometimes the shopkeeper doesn't know how to use his own tools either.
Oh? It's you. I have some things to buy - a good deal of what the shrine uses is actually sourced here.
It's a fairly large secondhand shop, after all — but the goods he sells are pretty unusual.
gensokyolegacy/reimu/visit_kourindou/sta: What a coincidence - you are shopping here too?
This shop has a good deal more in stock than it looks.
gensokyolegacy/sakuya/chat/party_greetin: This time I'm the one being entertained. If you're short-handed, I can teach you how to raise an excellent maid one day.
gensokyolegacy/sakuya/chat/trade: Does the Scarlet Devil Mansion sell anything to outsiders?
gensokyolegacy/sakuya/gift/dialog/dislik: I'm sorry, Scarlet Devil Mansion has no use for this. Please keep it.
gensokyolegacy/sakuya/gift/dialog/like: This looks like something the young lady would like. I'll take it.
gensokyolegacy/sakuya/gift/dialog/neutra: I may have no use for it, but I'll accept your kindness all the same.
gensokyolegacy/sakuya/gift/dialog/return: Take this, with the young lady's compliments. It is only a small thing.
gensokyolegacy/sakuya/visit_morichika_sh: The young lady's requests are sometimes more than an ordinary shop can satisfy. One always finds something worthwhile here, if the goods are unusual.
Does the mansion do its shopping here as well?
gensokyolegacy/suika/chat/greeting: Welcome to my turf! Fancy a drinking contest?
gensokyolegacy/suika/chat/party_greeting: Yo, I'm here for the feast — you'd better show me a good time.
gensokyolegacy/suika/chat/visit_greeting: Oh? You came too. I'm enjoying a nice little buzz right now.
gensokyolegacy/suika/gift/dialog/dislike: Hey hey, I don't take just anything. Think it over before you hand it over.
gensokyolegacy/suika/gift/dialog/like: Now you're talking — you know what we like, so I won't be shy about it~
gensokyolegacy/suika/gift/dialog/neutral: Looks pretty ordinary, but it's the thought that counts. I'll take it.
gensokyolegacy/suika/gift/dialog/return: This does nothing for me, so I'm giving it to you. Come drink with me again~
gensokyolegacy/suika/gift/option/return/: My tolerance isn't great, so go easy on me!
gensokyolegacy/yuyuko/chat/greeting: My, my~ I seem to have wandered quite far, and met such a lively friend.
gensokyolegacy/yuyuko/chat/party_greetin: I never thought I'd receive an invitation from the outside world. Thank you for your hospitality.
gensokyolegacy/yuyuko/gift/dialog/dislik: I'm sorry, but I can't accept this one.
gensokyolegacy/yuyuko/gift/dialog/like: Such a delicate gift. I'm delighted — thank you.
gensokyolegacy/yuyuko/gift/dialog/neutra: Another gift? You're too kind. I'll accept it, then.
gensokyolegacy/yuyuko/gift/dialog/return: This is for you. I hope you'll like it too.
patchouli.gensokyolegacy.landing: This volume documents the working side of Gensokyo Legacy: brewing in the Alchemy Pot, paper talismans, combat dolls and their glove, special and everyday tools, and the decoration blocks you can sit on, cover and slide.
patchouli.gensokyolegacy.title: Gensokyo Tools Guide
